title: Procyanidin B2 Ameliorates Acute Alcoholic Liver Injury by Suppressing the PI3K-Akt/NF-kappaB Signaling Pathway to Regulate Oxidative Stress and Inflammatory Response.
authors: Guo, Jianjin; Li, Zhaohuan; Gao, Jing; Guo, Yan; Hou, Yufei; Lin, Shaoding; Chen, Xia; Zhu, Liangdong
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究原花青素B2对酒精性肝损伤的保护作用，涉及分子对接与MD模拟但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Acute alcoholic liver injury is a significant clinical challenge with complex pathogenesis. This study systematically investigated the hepatoprotective effect of procyanidin B2 (PB2) using an integrated approach combining network pharmacology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and in vivo/in vitro validation. Network analysis identified 161 common targets and highlighted the PI3K-Akt/NF-kappaB pathway as central. PB2 demonstrated high binding affinity to core targets such as SRC. In a mouse model, PB2 intervention significantly attenuated histopathological damage, reduced oxidative stress markers, improved lipid profiles, and suppressed pro-inflammatory cytokines while enhancing IL-10 expression. Western blot analysis confirmed PB2 dose-dependently inhibited phosphorylation of key proteins in the PI3K-Akt and NF-kappaB pathways. Cellular experiments further validated that PB2 alleviated ethanol-induced injury, apoptosis, and inflammatory response. These findings reveal that PB2 exerts protective effects against acute alcoholic liver injury primarily by modulating the PI3K-Akt/NF-kappaB signaling axis, offering a promising natural therapeutic candidate.
abstract_zh: 急性酒精性肝损伤是一个具有复杂发病机制的重大临床挑战。本研究采用网络药理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟及体内/体外验证相结合的综合方法，系统研究了原花青素B2（PB2）的保肝作用。网络分析识别出161个共同靶点，并突出PI3K-Akt/NF-kappaB通路为核心。PB2对核心靶点如SRC表现出高结合亲和力。在小鼠模型中，PB2干预显著减轻了组织病理学损伤，降低了氧化应激标志物，改善了脂质谱，并抑制了促炎细胞因子，同时增强了IL-10的表达。Western blot分析证实，PB2剂量依赖性地抑制了PI3K-Akt和NF-kappaB通路中关键蛋白的磷酸化。细胞实验进一步验证了PB2可减轻乙醇诱导的损伤、凋亡和炎症反应。这些发现表明，PB2主要通过调节PI3K-Akt/NF-kappaB信号轴对急性酒精性肝损伤发挥保护作用，为天然治疗候选药物提供了有前景的选择。
